§金法務
GL-01準據法與管轄法院Governing Law and Jurisdiction通用版短版⌃
因本契約所生或與本契約有關之一切爭議，包括本契約之解釋、效力、履行或執行，雙方應先依誠信原則協商解決，協商不成而涉訟時，本契約應以【中華民國法律】為準據法，雙方並合意以【臺灣臺北地方法院】為第一審管轄法院。
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, including any dispute concerning its interpretation, validity, performance or enforcement, shall first be resolved through good-faith consultation between the parties. If no resolution can be reached through such consultation and legal proceedings are commenced, this Agreement shall be governed by the laws of [Taiwan], and the parties agree that the [Taiwan Taipei District Court] shall have jurisdiction as the court of first instance.
